function.name: linsing_check
function.description: Check an audio file's length for lin-sing (max 10 minutes; over 5 minutes it works but may make the computer stutter).

function.name: linsing_make
function.description: Make lin sing a song: separates the voice, finds the lyrics and every syllable, builds the face track, analyses the music and writes an automatic choreography and camera. Takes minutes. Returns the song folder.

lyrics.description: optional lyrics file (.lrc with times or plain .txt)

function.name: linsing_get_choreo
function.description: Read the dope sheet of a song folder: a list of {t, end, move, level} and the moves that exist.

function.name: linsing_set_choreo
function.description: Replace the dope sheet (list of {t, end, move, level}) of a song folder and re-bake body, eyes and camera.

function.name: linsing_render
function.description: Render the song folder with Unity into an mp4 (the Unity editor opens and closes by itself).
